status: post-opening falsification gate frozen before placebo endpoint readback
purpose: Test whether the species ranking called activation geometry is specific to wetter-condition gain placement or is largely reproduced by rain-independent co-occurrence structure.

headline_family.rule: the 16 species in the frozen non-overlapping temporal validation family

focal_trait.name: wet_gain_geometry_all_years
focal_trait.definition: Across all 2001-2015 matched wetter-drier pairs, fit the same opportunity-corrected species geometry used by RC6: wet-gain incidence at a drier-run inactive stop versus a drier-run already-active stop, with offset logit(q_dry), where q_dry is the drier-run inactive-stop fraction.
focal_trait.model: intercept-only grouped binomial GLM with logit(q_dry) offset and route-clustered covariance
focal_trait.species_eligibility: headline family is fixed; each metric additionally requires >=30 informative incidences across >=10 routes and >=15 informative pairs

placebo_1_reverse_direction.name: reverse_dry_gain_geometry
placebo_1_reverse_direction.definition: For dry-gain incidences (species detected at a stop only in the drier run), success means the paired wetter-run stop is acoustically inactive and failure means that wetter-run stop is already active; offset is logit(q_wet), where q_wet is the wetter-run inactive-stop fraction.
placebo_1_reverse_direction.rationale: A stable species co-occurrence/solitude tendency should generate similar species ordering even when the wetter-drier direction is reversed.

placebo_2_low_contrast.name: low_contrast_wet_geometry
placebo_2_low_contrast.pair_rule: Use the bottom quartile of positive rain_contrast across the frozen 4,236 matched pairs. The quartile cutpoint is determined from the predictor distribution only, before geometry endpoint readback.
placebo_2_low_contrast.rationale: If species ordering persists when paired surveys differ only weakly in rainfall recency, the ordering may reflect stable co-occurrence structure rather than a rainfall-specific response mode.

baseline_cooccurrence.raw_metric: For each headline species across all eligible runs, fraction of its species-stop detections occurring at a stop with exactly one calling species total.
baseline_cooccurrence.opportunity_corrected_metric: For each species occurrence, success=singleton active stop and failure=multispecies active stop; offset logit(q_singleton_run), where q_singleton_run is the fraction of active stops in that run that are singleton. Use only 0<q_singleton_run<1 and fit the same intercept-only clustered binomial model.
baseline_cooccurrence.name: baseline_solitude_geometry
baseline_cooccurrence.rationale: This directly tests the proposed alternative that geometry is mostly a stable tendency to occur alone versus in multispecies calling assemblages.

coupling_rule.metric: Spearman rank correlation across fixed headline species with both quantities estimable
coupling_rule.threshold_origin: Reuse the already frozen strong-coupling threshold from NAAMP_RESPONSE_GEOMETRY_VS_MAGNITUDE_CONTRACT_V0_1.json rather than inventing a new post hoc standard.

retain_activation_geometry_in_title_if: wet_gain_geometry versus reverse_dry_gain_geometry does NOT meet strong_same_rank_coupling
wet_gain_geometry versus low_contrast_wet_geometry does NOT meet strong_same_rank_coupling
wet_gain_geometry versus baseline_solitude_geometry does NOT meet strong_same_rank_coupling
headline_gate.demote_if: Any one of the three primary placebo/baseline comparisons meets strong_same_rank_coupling.
headline_gate.raw_singleton_fraction: Reported as a descriptive corroboration and not a separate gate.

secondary_outputs: Pairwise scatter tables for all four geometry quantities
Spearman correlation between wet geometry and raw singleton fraction
WLS wet geometry on each placebo/baseline score weighted by inverse wet-geometry variance; descriptive only
Low-contrast quartile cutpoint and sample-size diagnostics
interpretation_if_pass: Activation geometry is not strongly reproduced by reverse-direction gains, near-zero rainfall-contrast gains, or baseline solitude tendency, supporting its use as a rainfall-associated response geometry.
interpretation_if_fail: Activation geometry is substantially compatible with a stable species co-occurrence/solitude property. Remove it from the title and main novelty claim; retain temporal/route repeatability as a descriptive species property in Supporting Information.
boundaries: This is a falsification gate for interpretation, not proof of causality.
The low-contrast placebo is relative to the observed rain-contrast distribution, not truly zero rainfall difference.
Baseline solitude is an acoustic co-occurrence property, not habitat occupancy.
No alternative placebo definition, threshold, species family or decision rule may replace this frozen specification after readback.
